beginner.summary: For developers and DevOps engineers who have called an LLM API and now need to run an LLM application reliably. Covers a local lab, provider SDK usage and errors, configuration and key hygiene, prompts as versioned Git artifacts, model pinning, a LiteLLM gateway with virtual keys, budgets, retries and fallbacks, rate limits, token cost calculation, structured logging, first Langfuse traces, latency metrics, exact and prompt caching, local models with Ollama, golden-set tests in CI, PII handling, and a support-bot capstone.
prerequisites: Writes and runs Python 3.10 or later scripts and uses pip or uv
Uses Git, a terminal and Docker Compose at a basic level
Has an API key for at least one LLM provider with a small spend limit
outcomes: Run an LLM gateway with scoped keys, budgets, retries and fallbacks in front of provider models
Version prompts and models and test changes with a golden set in CI
Trace, log and cost every LLM call without storing sensitive text
Deliver a small LLM service with a runbook an on-call engineer can follow
